summary: Sabre Corp's 8-K reports the issuance of $150M 7.00% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2031 by subsidiary Sabre GLBL Inc., guaranteed by Sabre and Sabre Holdings. The notes exchange into Sabre common stock at an initial exchange price of ~$2.24/share (447.2272 shares per $1,000 principal). Interest is paid semi-annually; maturity is 2031. Redemption is allowed from 2029 if stock exceeds 130% of exchange price. This is a debt capital-raising transaction, not a special situation like a buyback or dividend. Watch for dilution upon exchange or any future use of proceeds for shareholder returns.
